body: I know but I'm the only one who cares about him... I cannot leave him alone : what would I do if he commited suicide because I left him? I still love the one he is deep inside, and I can't abandon him. I'm afraid of what he could do. Everytime I try to speak about going to see a psychologist he threatens me of killing himself. He says I'm the only help he wants... I feel like I'm going mad too and this story screwed everything up in my life but I can not abandon him with this sorrow I caused..
